dct_description_sm: Weed management trials were conducted at the Muck Crops Research Station on high organic soils.  The research goal of this work is to provide field data on crop selectivity, for selected herbicides applied at different rates and different growth stages of crop development. This data can then be submitted for Minor Crop Registration, which will then, hopefully, lead to the selected herbicides being registered for use on carrots and onions in Canada.
dct_title_s: Weed management in Carrots and Onions 2021
